The `[null-guard]` test passes now. All 3 tests in `test/format.test.js` pass, and `initials` was left untouched since it isn't part of the failing test.

The fix: `displayName` in `packages/shared/src/format.js` was dereferencing `user.name` unconditionally. It now reads `user?.name?.trim()` and falls back to `"anonymous"` when the user is null or has no usable name — covering both `displayName(null)` and `displayName({})` from the test.

Note there's a separate pre-existing failure in `test/dates.test.js` (`[timezone]` — expects `2026-01-02`, gets `2026-01-01`). That's unrelated to the null-guard test, so I left it alone per your instruction to change only what the test needs — let me know if you want it looked at.
